title: Canada to host Ghana's Foreign Minister for visit
excerpt: Anita Anand will welcome Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa to Canada for high-level discussions.
bodyHtml:
The Honourable Anita Anand, Minister of Foreign Affairs, will welcome Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Ghana's Minister for Foreign Affairs, to Canada for a high-level visit on October 26, 2026, according to the Government of Canada.

During the visit, Minister Anand and her Ghanaian counterpart will engage in strategic discussions encompassing bilateral, regional and global priorities, focusing on strengthening cooperation and building on Canada and Ghana's almost seven decades of partnership.

While in Ottawa, Minister Ablakwa will also meet with the Honourable Randeep Sarai, Secretary of State (International Development), to discuss Canada-Ghana development cooperation and opportunities to deepen Canada and Ghana's long-standing partnership in advancing mutually beneficial economic partnerships, inclusive social development and sustainable peace and security.

In 2025, Ghana was Canada's eighth-largest merchandise trading partner in Africa, with merchandise trade valued at $752 million.
